observations.trace: Server scene creation spawns a Replicated entity and inserts the optional TerrainLandformRecipe. The startup source passes input.landform after generating the scene. The replication plugin registers TerrainLandformRecipe with replicate_once and no custom RuleFns; its neighboring SceneBuilding explicitly has a JSON-in-Postcard rule. Client terrain presentation queries the optional recipe and its spawn path uses it to prepare a patch and transition collar.
observations.remaining: This source path does not show an actual scene, network delivery, decode event, client error handling, rendering or player effect. The separate building fixture source was not executed and is not a landform test.

observations.trace: Pinned Replicon0.41.1 replicate_once chooses default RuleFns; its default serializer and deserializer call postcard_utils, whose from_buf constructs Postcard1.1.3 Deserializer. The landform type deserializes through QuantizedLandformRecipe; its surface deserializes through SurfaceWire, which contains TerrainGeologicStructure. That enum derives Deserialize with serde(tag=kind). Pinned serde_derive1.0.229 generates deserialize_any for internally tagged enums; postcard deserialize_any returns WontImplement. Therefore, if the ordinary decoded wire reaches the structure field under these selected rules, decoding stops before the checked surface and landform TryFrom factories, for Massive, Bedded and Foliated alike.
observations.remaining: This conclusion follows inspected source and pinned archive identities; no expanded macro, postcard codec, packet or product ran. Serialization, feature/target configuration, all possible alternate registrations, protocol handling and acceptance checks remain open.

observations.trace: TerrainSurfaceRecipe::new infers structure from a named preset, seed and tangent; from_structure instead accepts an explicitly supplied structure and validates its numerical leaves. StreamId owns each static purpose after the helper constructs it. The grounding contract source includes authored decoding and extreme finite support assertions, not observed results.
observations.remaining: Whether arbitrary valid structure is an intentional authoring override, Mapped provenance authority, private purpose ownership, independent lenses and all production callers remain open.

conditional_findings.first_contract: The selected replication codec must decode every admitted TerrainGeologicStructure carried by TerrainLandformRecipe before checked recipe admission.
conditional_findings.source_conclusion: Given a default Replicon0.41.1 component decode that reaches the nested TerrainGeologicStructure, serde_derive1.0.229 requests deserialize_any for its internally tagged enum; Postcard1.1.3 unconditionally returns WontImplement. The request occurs before variant dispatch, so it applies to Massive, Bedded and Foliated. Both surface and landform try_from factories follow successful wire deserialization, so this failure precedes those factories.
conditional_findings.actual_source_path: The tactical server may insert an optional landform on the Replicated scene entity. Tactical netcode registers that component via replicate_once default rule; the client queries the recipe when generating patch/collar presentation. This establishes source-level integration, not observed packet arrival or presentation.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: SceneBuilding has its own JSON envelope rule; that rule belongs to a different component and does not establish a landform roundtrip. JSON document admission and non-network local preparation remain separate paths.
conditional_findings.effect_and_limits: A selected default decode reaching this field returns the Postcard error rather than an admitted landform component. Session behavior, other registrations, actual generated input, all transport variants and user-visible impact remain unobserved.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: Design one deliberate transport representation for the recipe that the selected binary codec can decode through the same checked factories, preserving documented JSON behavior where separately required; no compatibility shims. This is a ledger recommendation only.
